words.engDef: a person trained to prepare and sell medicines
words.example: The company is seeking a qualified pharmacist to manage the in-house pharmacy.
words.chinese: 藥師，負責調劑和銷售藥品，並提供藥物相關諮詢的專業人員。

words.chinese: 分階段的；逐步實施的

words.engDef: a long thin rounded piece of wood or metal

words.engDef: a person who works in government or seeks elected office

words.engDef: harmful substances that damage the air, water, or land
words.example: The company is investing in new technologies to reduce pollution from its manufacturing processes.

words.engDef: has or owns something

words.example: The company is sourcing unique pottery for its new hotel gift shop.
words.chinese: 陶器；陶瓷製品（通常指手工製作或裝飾性的物品）

words.example: The sudden drop in sales precipitated a review of the company's marketing strategy.

words.engDef: a difficult situation with no easy way out
words.example: The company found itself in a difficult predicament after the sudden drop in sales.

words.chinese: 預測；預估；預言

words.engDef: better than all others in a particular field
words.example: Our company is the preeminent provider of cloud storage solutions in the region.
words.chinese: 卓越的；首屈一指的；在...方面具有支配地位的

words.engDef: a professional; also an argument in favour of something

words.chinese: 專業人士；專家；支持者

words.engDef: a series of actions taken to achieve a result

words.chinese: 流程；處理程序；步驟

words.engDef: a person who designs how a product looks and works
words.example: Our company is seeking a talented product designer to lead the development of our new mobile app.

words.engDef: the process of moving forward or developing in stages
words.example: The company is pleased with the progression of the new project, which is ahead of schedule.

words.engDef: gradually, in a series of steps

words.example: The project coordinator is responsible for tracking progress and addressing any roadblocks.

words.engDef: the work of planning and controlling a project
words.example: Effective project management is crucial for ensuring the timely completion of the new product launch.

words.example: The proprietor of the restaurant is responsible for ensuring food safety standards are met.

words.engDef: to be successful, especially financially
words.example: Many businesses prospered during the economic boom.

words.engDef: successful and wealthy

words.chinese: 繁榮的；昌盛的；成功的

words.engDef: to set up a system or rule so it can be used

words.engDef: to start using a plan or rule

words.engDef: the checks made to keep products at a set standard

words.engDef: to send out heat, light, or energy

words.chinese: 徹底地；根本地；大幅度地（表示改變或不同程度的變化）

words.engDef: a storm with a lot of rain

words.chinese: 暴風雨；強烈降雨，通常伴隨雷電和強風。

words.chinese: 清理落葉；耙除落葉

words.chinese: 牧場；大型農場（通常指畜牧業或耕種的農場）

words.chinese: 衝動地；不經過深思熟慮地

words.engDef: a fixed amount of something allowed to each person

words.chinese: 配給量；定額；（尤指戰時或困難時期）定量供應

words.chinese: 找到解決方案；達成目標

words.chinese: 反應性的；回應的；易起反應的

words.chinese: 反彈；恢復；彈回

words.chinese: 重建;重現;修復

words.engDef: the process of building something again after damage

words.chinese: 重建；復原；修復。常用於建築、社會、經濟等領域。

words.chinese: 休閒活動，通常指工作或學習之外的娛樂或放鬆活動。

words.chinese: 減少；降低（數量、成本、風險等）

words.chinese: 提煉廠；精煉廠

words.engDef: to get back something you had lost

words.engDef: relating to one particular area of a country

words.chinese: 區域性的；屬於特定區域的

words.chinese: 區域主管，負責特定區域業務的管理者。

words.engDef: an official rule that controls how something is done

words.engDef: to make something stronger

words.chinese: 強化；鞏固；增強

words.engDef: depending on someone or something

words.chinese: 依賴；依靠；信賴

words.chinese: 放棄；讓渡（權利、權利主張等）

words.engDef: to change the structure or appearance of a building
words.example: The company plans to remodel the office space to improve employee productivity.
words.chinese: 重新裝修；翻新（建築物、空間等）

words.chinese: 可再生資源，指能自然補充或再生，且使用後不會枯竭的資源。

words.chinese: 裝修；翻新（通常指對現有建築物或空間進行改善或更新）

words.engDef: a man whose job is to fix machines
words.example: The repairman will be at your office tomorrow to fix the faulty printer.

words.example: We need to schedule a repairperson to fix the faulty machinery as soon as possible.
words.chinese: 維修人員；保養維修技術人員

words.engDef: known to be honest and to do good work
words.example: Our company partners with reputable suppliers to ensure high-quality materials.
words.chinese: 享有盛譽的；信譽良好的

words.engDef: the money, materials, and people available for use

words.chinese: 資源；可用於達成目標的人力、物力、財力或資訊。

words.engDef: the parts of the body used for breathing

words.chinese: 呼吸系統，指負責吸入氧氣和呼出二氧化碳的器官系統。

words.engDef: brought back to its original condition

words.chinese: 修復；恢復（原樣或功能）

words.engDef: official rules limiting what may be done
words.example: Due to current travel restrictions, business trips abroad are temporarily suspended.
words.chinese: 限制、約束，通常指對行為、活動或程序的規定。

words.engDef: to change the way an organisation is arranged
words.example: The company decided to restructure its departments to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 重新組織；重組；調整結構

words.engDef: to cause a particular outcome

words.chinese: 導致；造成（某種結果或後果）

words.engDef: looking back at past events; also an exhibition of past work
words.example: The company conducted a retrospective analysis of the project to identify areas for improvement.
words.chinese: 回顧性分析；事後檢討

words.engDef: a person who examines and judges something
words.example: The marketing team needs to send the new brochure to several reviewers before the official launch.
words.chinese: 審稿人；評論員（通常指對產品、服務或文件進行評估和提供意見的人）

words.engDef: equipment for a particular purpose; also to arrange dishonestly

words.chinese: 裝置；鑽油平台；索具；（不公正地）操縱；裝配；架設

words.engDef: the chances that something bad will happen
words.example: The company conducted a thorough risk assessment before launching the new product.
words.chinese: 風險；危險；冒險

words.engDef: to move a boat using oars
words.example: Let's row the boat together to achieve our quarterly sales targets.
words.chinese: 划船；（比喻）合作，共同努力

words.engDef: to spread out towards different places at once
words.example: The company's marketing campaigns often run in several directions to reach a wider audience.
words.chinese: 分散開來，朝多個方向發展

words.engDef: to be in danger of something bad happening

words.chinese: 冒險；有…的風險

words.chinese: 打開水龍頭（讓水流出），通常指持續讓水流動。

words.chinese: 影片或影音作品的播放時間長度。

words.engDef: an official check that a place or machine is safe

words.engDef: clean and unlikely to cause disease

words.chinese: 符合衛生標準的；清潔衛生的

words.chinese: 維修服務中心；維護據點（通常指交通工具或設備的維修和保養場所）

words.engDef: to achieve the best result so far

words.engDef: people who move to live in a new area
words.example: The company is exploring opportunities to establish new settlements in developing regions.
words.chinese: 拓荒者；定居者（通常指在新的地區建立家園的人）

words.engDef: to cut something off, or to end a connection

words.chinese: 切斷；中斷（關係、聯繫等）

words.engDef: waste water and material carried away in drains

words.engDef: to divide into parts, or to share between people

words.engDef: to make a process simpler and more efficient

words.chinese: 放棄；交出（權利、控制權等）；投降

words.chinese: 可持續的；能夠長期維持的，尤其指環境、經濟或社會效益。

words.engDef: relating to the methods used to achieve a short-term aim

words.chinese: 戰術的；策略的；有謀略的；與戰術相關的

words.chinese: 品味優雅地；具有良好品味地（通常指設計、裝飾或行為），避免過於花哨或冒犯。

words.chinese: 拆除；將...拆毀（建築物、結構等）

words.chinese: 牙齒（複數）；牙齒的集合。

words.chinese: 理論；假說；學說（通常指經過研究或分析提出的解釋）

words.engDef: careful about spending money

words.chinese: 節儉的；精打細算的，尤其指在花費上

words.engDef: growing and doing very well

words.engDef: one of a set of levels arranged one above another

words.engDef: a calm and peaceful state

words.chinese: 平靜、安寧，尤指免於喧囂和煩惱的狀態。

words.chinese: 轉變；改變（形式、結構或性質）

words.engDef: the thick main stem of a tree

words.chinese: 修剪；裁剪；減少（成本、時間等）

words.example: The new marketing campaign is expected to unleash a wave of customer interest.
words.chinese: 釋放；發揮（潛力、力量等）；讓…自由

words.engDef: dirty and likely to cause disease
words.example: The health inspector found the kitchen unsanitary and ordered it to be closed until it met the required standards.
words.chinese: 不衛生、不潔，指環境或條件不符合衛生標準，可能導致疾病傳播。

words.engDef: likely to change or fall suddenly
words.example: The company's financial situation is currently unstable due to the recent market fluctuations.
words.chinese: 不穩定的；搖搖欲墜的；容易變化的

words.engDef: happening earlier than expected, or at a bad moment
words.example: The project's untimely termination resulted in significant financial losses.
words.chinese: 不合時宜的；過早的；過於及時的（通常指令人遺憾的事件）

words.engDef: rising and falling repeatedly
words.example: The stock market has been extremely up-and-down this week due to economic uncertainty.
words.chinese: 上下；波動；起伏（指價格、數據或表現的變化）

words.engDef: basic public services such as water, gas, and electricity
words.example: The company is trying to reduce its utility costs by implementing energy-saving measures.
words.chinese: 公用事業；水電瓦斯等生活必需設施

words.engDef: a company that supplies water, gas, or electricity
words.example: Our company is negotiating a new contract with the utility provider to reduce energy costs.
words.chinese: 公用事業供應商，指提供水、電、瓦斯等基本公共服務的公司。

words.engDef: the use of something for a practical purpose
words.example: The company is focusing on maximizing the utilization of its existing resources.
words.chinese: 利用；運用；應用（資源、技術等）

words.engDef: cleaning a floor with a vacuum cleaner
words.example: The cleaning staff is scheduled to be vacuuming the office floors this afternoon.
words.chinese: 吸塵清潔；用吸塵器清潔

words.engDef: in a way that changes from one time to another
words.example: The company's sales figures varied widely from month to month, making forecasting difficult.
words.chinese: 不穩定地；變動地；根據情況而異地

words.engDef: a difference between two figures or expectations
words.example: The actual sales showed a significant variance from the projected figures.
words.chinese: 差異；分歧；變數；（統計學）變異數

words.engDef: the movement of fresh air into and out of a building
words.example: The office building has a state-of-the-art ventilation system to ensure a healthy working environment.
words.chinese: 通風系統；通風設備，指提供新鮮空氣並排除廢氣的系統或過程。

words.engDef: relating to the medical care of animals
words.example: The company's health insurance plan covers veterinary care for employees' pets.
words.chinese: 獸醫的；與獸醫或獸醫學相關的。

words.engDef: a chain of events in which each problem makes the next worse
words.example: The company's high employee turnover rate creates a vicious cycle: inexperienced staff lead to poor customer service, which drives customers away, forcing the company to hire even more inexperienced staff.
words.chinese: 惡性循環；一種自我強化且難以打破的負面模式，其中一個問題導致另一個問題，進而加劇最初的問題。

words.engDef: how far or how clearly something can be seen
words.example: Due to the dense fog, the visibility on the highway was severely reduced, causing traffic delays.
words.chinese: 能見度；能清楚看見的範圍

words.engDef: in a way that is extremely important
words.example: The project's success vitally depends on securing funding by the end of the quarter.
words.chinese: 至關重要地；極其重要地

words.engDef: easily harmed or affected by something
words.example: The company's network is vulnerable to cyberattacks, so we need to strengthen our security measures.
words.chinese: 易受...影響；容易受到...攻擊或危害

words.engDef: a room where people sit until they are seen
words.example: Patients are requested to wait in the waiting room until their names are called.
words.chinese: 等候室；通常位於診所、醫院、辦公室等場所，供人們在等待服務或會議時休息的區域。

words.engDef: an event that warns people they must act
words.example: The declining sales figures served as a wake-up call for the marketing team to revise their strategy.
words.chinese: 警醒電話；提醒事件，通常指某事發生後發出的電話，以喚醒人們注意並採取行動。

words.engDef: a frame used to help someone walk; also a person walking
words.example: The company is adapting the office layout to accommodate employees using walkers.
words.chinese: （尤指老年人或行動不便者使用的）助行器；拐杖

words.engDef: to become gradually weaker or smaller
words.example: The company's market share began to wane after the introduction of a competitor's product.
words.chinese: （月亮、星星等）逐漸減弱、衰退；（影響、熱情等）逐漸消退

words.engDef: to clean a car with water
words.example: The company's fleet manager is responsible for scheduling regular car washes to maintain the vehicles' appearance.
words.chinese: 清洗汽車

words.engDef: a machine that washes clothes
words.example: The office manager needs to order a new washing machine for the employee laundry room.
words.chinese: 洗衣機，用於清洗衣物的家用電器，常見於辦公室或商業洗衣服務。

words.engDef: a complete failure
words.example: The marketing campaign was a complete washout due to poor planning and execution.
words.chinese: （計畫、活動等）失敗、泡湯；（人）被淘汰、被除名

words.engDef: the strap that holds a watch on the wrist
words.example: We need to order more watch bands in bulk to meet the increased demand.
words.chinese: 手錶錶帶；手錶鏈

words.engDef: to look after and protect someone or something
words.example: The security team is responsible for watching over the warehouse to prevent theft.
words.chinese: 監督；看顧；負責監控或保護

words.engDef: the height that the surface of water reaches
words.example: The factory needs to monitor the water level in the reservoir to ensure a stable supply for production.
words.chinese: 水位，液面高度

words.engDef: to pour water on plants so they grow
words.example: The office manager reminded everyone to water the plants during the weekend.
words.chinese: 澆灌植物

words.engDef: a container with a spout used for watering plants
words.example: The groundskeeper uses a watering can to ensure the plants in the lobby remain healthy.
words.chinese: 澆水器，用於澆灌植物的容器。

words.engDef: the damage caused by ordinary daily use
words.example: The company needs to budget for wear and tear on the machinery.
words.chinese: 磨損、損耗（通常指設備或物品因使用而產生的自然損壞）

words.engDef: the joining of metal parts by heating them
words.example: The quality control department is inspecting the welding on the new bridge structure.
words.chinese: 焊接；將材料藉由熱能或壓力使其結合的過程。

words.engDef: having all the parts in the right proportion
words.example: The company's budget is well-balanced, allocating resources effectively across departments.
words.chinese: 結構合理且各方面協調的；營養均衡的；（計畫、策略等）周全且具備多方考量。

words.engDef: to bring something to an end; also to close a company
words.example: The project manager needs to wind up the meeting by 5:00 PM to ensure everyone can catch their trains.
words.chinese: 結束；收尾；將...捲起來

words.engDef: a storm with very strong winds
words.example: The company temporarily suspended operations due to the approaching windstorm.
words.chinese: 強風暴；狂風暴雨，通常伴隨強風和暴雨，可能造成嚴重損害。

words.engDef: to be strong enough not to be harmed by something
words.example: The new building is designed to withstand earthquakes and strong winds.
words.chinese: 承受、經受、抵擋（壓力、衝擊等）

words.engDef: gained victory or a prize
words.example: Our company won the contract after a competitive bidding process.
words.chinese: 贏得；獲勝

words.engDef: the parts of a building made of wood; also the craft of shaping wood
words.example: The company is looking for a skilled woodworker to create custom furniture for the new office.
words.chinese: 木工；木工藝品；木工部門

words.engDef: a strong table used for making or repairing things
words.example: The technician needs a clean workbench to repair the electronic device.
words.chinese: 工作台；工作檯面，通常指用於修理、組裝或進行手工作業的桌面。

words.engDef: sessions of physical exercise
words.example: The company offers employees subsidized gym memberships to encourage regular workouts.
words.chinese: 鍛鍊；訓練（通常指定期進行的身體活動）

words.engDef: happening in or covering the whole world
words.example: Our company has a worldwide network of distributors.
words.chinese: 全球性的；遍及全球的

words.engDef: to become worse or make something worse
words.example: The company's financial situation worsened significantly after the economic downturn.
words.chinese: 惡化；使情況更糟
